Our Story

From a Cosmic Jacuzzi to a Digital Laboratory

It started around 2020 with a pencil, a piece of paper, and a mushroom who apparently needed a vacation.

That happy little mushroom became the mascot of Matty's Mushies. Years later, an idea for organizing culture records grew into MycoLab, a personal workspace for documenting cultures, projects, photos, prepared batches, inventory, and their connections.

Made with curiosity, caffeine, and an unreasonable appreciation for fungi. ☕🍄
